Hi everyone! If you haven't heard the Eternal Edge + game is now out of early access!! We also released a free prologue of the game that allows you to enjoy the beginning of the Eternal Edge + experience before buying the full game! notes.title: Eternal Edge + Release Coming Soon!
notes.content:

[h1]Eternal Edge Plus Releasing Soon![/h1]

Hi everyone! We're excited to announce that we will be releasing Eternal Edge soon, we're still working on an exact date but were aiming for some time end of this month! The devs have been working hard at improving combat, content, visual improvements, optimizations, bug fixing and more.

The game has come a long way from launch and we're excited to show you how it's been progressing. Today we released a new trailer highlighting updates the game has had so far along with a new introduction to the game.

notes.title: Isle of Jura - A relaxing fishing adventure game is releasing Feb. 11th!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32748159/9258df30ccccc72201162c0bbc198fe851a74d1e.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Villagers![/h1]

We are excited to share that the Isle of Jura game will be released this Friday, Feb. 11th! We can't wait to see what you all catch in Isle of Jura. We've just uploaded a new build with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1703140/view/3130567756993437861]bug fixes and QOL updates.[/url]

See you on launch day!

[h2]About the Game[/h2]

Alex needs to finish her biology report! Looking for species to study, she's taking a fishing trip to Jura, a remote and beautiful island.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Catch over 50 species of fish
[*] Master 3 different fishing techniques
[*] Find artifacts and complete the island collection
[*] Chat with the island residents
[*] Explore at your own pace
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1703140/Isle_of_Jura/

notes.title: Abyss The Forgotten Past: Prologue (for FREE)!! Releasing TODAY
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32748159/4bff16ab31c29e8ac08cd190159c0808928edf96.gif[/img]

[h1]Abyss the Forgotten Past: Prologue RELEASE DAY[/h1]


Hi everyone! The Sedoc Publishing team are super thrilled to be working with One Way Games to release Abyss the Forgotten Past: Prologue. We will be releasing it this afternoon. If you haven't already wishlist the game to get notified on release:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1453140/Abyss_The_Forgotten_Past_Prologue/

[b]About the game[/b]
Abyss the Forgotten past is a 2D platformer with RPG elements.

Skeletons, Celestial Beings, Magic Swords and a vast beautiful world created in pixel art. All this together with an adventure full of mysteries and puzzles that cannot be told in just one story. Here is a brief summary of what can be found in Abyss The Forgotten Past.

Abyss The Forgotten Past: Prologue, is the begining of Leonnor's Tales, play the introduction and Alton's Island with 5 playable stages + Bônus 2 Ice stages

The plot was initially based on a table RPG game played in real life. The story is based on rediscovering itself, after an unfortunate event, Leonnor sets out on a journey to discover everything about his past, with special abilities, where monsters, magic and heavenly beings exist. Enter a personal search that will surprise you with each discovery ...

[b]Will be releasing with 8 Languages!![/b]

[list]
[*] English
[*] Portuguese
[*] Italian
[*] Czech
[*] Russian
[*] Chinese
[*] Turkish
[*] Spanish
[*] and German!
[/list]
